title: The FP64 routed SwiGLU block (expert-streamed-prefill)
description: expert-streamed-prefill's moe_block: each token's routes in order, SwiGLU between each expert's gate/up and down matrices, the outputs summed with the routing weights. Slow and exact: the reference every experts plugin is compared with, on the weights of the expert_source slot. Its device form runs the same block in torch over the experts' matrices loaded on the device, its products in FP64, each token's routes summed in route order; capture-safe at a fixed token count (rounds:experts) and inside a captured prompt chunk, whose padding's routes (ids -1) add nothing (prompts:experts).
